final: WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(rental_duration) AS ratio FROM film GROUP BY rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM rating_averages) SELECT r.rating, r.avg_replacement_cost, r.ratio, r.ratio / o.avg_ratio FROM rating_averages AS r CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL
